name: ASM · Client Report
description: Form (/form/asm-report): builds a client-ready ASM report for one engagement from asm_scope/runs/assets/findings. Writes PDF, HTML, CSV, JSON to /opt/loot/asm/<eng>/reports/<id>/, logs to asm_reports.

parameters.formDescription: Builds a client-ready external attack surface report (PDF, plus HTML, CSV and JSON on disk) for one engagement in asm_scope.

values.fieldLabel: Client name (as shown on the report)
Reporting period in days (0 = all time)

parameters.command:
=D='{{ $json.out_dir }}'
case "$D" in /opt/loot/asm/*/reports/*) ;; *) echo 'bad path' >&2; exit 1;; esac
mkdir -p -m 750 "$D" && echo ok

=D='{{ $('Report Params').first().json.out_dir }}'
IMG='zenika/alpine-chrome:124'
case "$D" in /opt/loot/asm/*/reports/*) ;; *) echo 'bad path' >&2; exit 1;; esac
docker image inspect "$IMG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || timeout 600 docker pull -q "$IMG" >"$D/pdf.log" 2>&1
if timeout 180 docker run --rm --network none --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$D:/work" "$IMG" --no-sandbox --headless --disable-gpu --disable-dev-shm-usage --no-pdf-header-footer --print-to-pdf=/work/report.pdf file:///work/report.html >>"$D/pdf.log" 2>&1 && [ -s "$D/report.pdf" ]; then echo pdf; else echo html; fi

values.json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ title: '📄 ASM report ready · ' + $('Report Params').first().json.client_name, color: 0x1F3A5F, fields: [{ name: 'Engagement', value: '`' + $('Report Params').first().json.engagement + '`', inline: true }, { name: 'Rating', value: $('Build Report Data').first().json.report.rating, inline: true }, { name: 'Open findings', value: String($('Build Report Data').first().json.report.stats.findings_open), inline: true }, { name: 'Output', value: '`' + $('Report Params').first().json.out_dir + '`' + ($('Render PDF').first().json.stdout.trim() === 'pdf' ? '' : ' (PDF render failed, HTML only)') }], footer: { text: 'ASM · Client Report' + ($('Report Params').first().json.requested_by ? ' · ' + $('Report Params').first().json.requested_by : '') }, timestamp: $now.toISO() }) }}

parameters.content:
## ASM · Client Report
Form at `/form/asm-report` (n8n login). Pulls `asm_scope`, `asm_runs`, `asm_assets` and `asm_findings` for one engagement, renders a client report and writes `report.html`, `report.pdf`, `findings.csv`, `assets.csv` and `report.json` to `/opt/loot/asm/<engagement>/reports/<id>/`.

PDF is rendered by headless Chrome in `zenika/alpine-chrome:124` with no network. If that fails the form returns the HTML instead. The Ollama summary is optional; without it a deterministic summary is used.

nodeGroups.name: Load engagement data
nodeGroups.description: Creates the report dir, reads the four asm_* tables for the engagement and builds the report model plus Ollama prompt.

nodeGroups.name: Write deliverables
nodeGroups.description: Writes HTML, CSV and JSON to the report dir, renders the PDF in headless Chrome (Docker, no network) and reads it back.

nodeGroups.name: Executive summary
nodeGroups.description: Optional Ollama-drafted summary (falls back to a deterministic one), then renders the HTML report, CSVs and JSON as binaries.
